page_listings.description:
Reach your desired sweetness in any food or beverage, without compromising your blood sugar level. Belta Coconut Sugar is a locally produced natural sugar made from the coconut palm sap. Its high nutritional content and low-glycemic index makes it a great substitute to table sugar. This can be used in various recipes in desserts, juices, sauces, and as a condiment.

Directions: Use as sugar replacement. 1 tsp Belta Coconut Sugar = 1 tsp Sugar.

Ingredients: Coconut Sugar
Storage: Store in a cool, dry place and in a tightly sealed container. Keep sealed after open
